question: What certificates are provided by WeIntern?
answer: Both WeIntern programs provide certificates: The 6-Month Program (₹7,999) includes the internship certificate AND all applicable program certificates. The 3-Month Program (₹999) includes the internship certificate and applicable certificates as well.

question: Will I get a certificate?
answer: Yes. Both the 6-Month Program (₹7,999) and the 3-Month Program (₹999) include an internship completion certificate and applicable program certificates. Certificates can be added to your LinkedIn profile.

question: What is the difference in certificates between programs?
answer: The 6-Month Program (₹7,999) provides the internship certificate plus all applicable program certificates (comprehensive). The 3-Month Program (₹999) includes the internship certificate and applicable certificates. Both are valid for LinkedIn and professional use.

question: Who is eligible for certificates?
answer: Students who successfully complete the required training, assignments, and live project/project outcomes as defined by their enrolled program (6-Month or 3-Month) are eligible for certificates.

question: What are the completion criteria for a certificate?
answer: For the 6-Month Program: Complete 2 months of industry-oriented training AND live project experience. For the 3-Month Program: Complete the industry training requirements. Both programs require meeting participation and submission standards.

question: How is the certificate verified?
answer: Certificate verification is handled through the official WeIntern process. Contact support at +91 74149 74582 (WhatsApp) or contact.weintern@gmail.com for the verification link or process after program completion.

question: Can I use the certificate on LinkedIn?
answer: Yes. The WeIntern internship certificate and program certificates can be added to your LinkedIn profile to showcase your training and project experience to recruiters and employers.

question: Will I get a professional completion certificate?
answer: Yes. Both programs issue a WeIntern verified completion certificate. The 6-Month Program additionally issues all applicable program-specific certificates alongside the internship certificate.

question: How do I show the certificate on my profile?
answer: You can add the WeIntern certificate to your LinkedIn 'Licenses & Certifications' section, include it on your resume under certifications, and feature it in your portfolio or GitHub profile.

question: How long is the certificate valid?
answer: WeIntern certificates are issued as permanent credentials. For specific validity queries, contact support at contact.weintern@gmail.com or +91 74149 74582.

question: WeIntern se certificate kaise milta hai?
answer: Dono programs mein certificate milta hai: 6-Month Program (₹7,999) mein internship certificate + sabhi applicable program certificates milte hain. 3-Month Program (₹999) mein internship certificate + applicable certificates milte hain. Certificate LinkedIn par bhi add kar sakte hain.

question: Kya certificate LinkedIn par show kar sakte hain?
answer: Haan. WeIntern ka internship certificate aur program certificates LinkedIn 'Licenses & Certifications' section mein add kiye ja sakte hain taaki recruiters aapki training aur project experience dekh sakein.

question: Certificate ke liye completion criteria kya hote hain?
answer: 6-Month Program mein: 2 months industry training + live project experience complete karna hota hai. 3-Month Program mein: industry training requirements complete karni hoti hain. Dono mein participation aur submissions required hain.

question: Certificate verification kaise hota hai?
answer: Official WeIntern verification process ke through certificate verify hota hai. Verification link ya process ke liye +91 74149 74582 par WhatsApp karein ya contact.weintern@gmail.com par email karein.
